column1: # jespersen's own Catalan word list (CC0), from standard central Catalan: words respelt for what the
# spelling rules would miss. One per line: the word in lower case, a tab, its respelling. An
# accent marks a stress or an open or closed vowel the rules would get wrong (tot → tót); a final
# rr keeps an r Catalan says (amor → amorr), a final vowel drops one it does not (flor → flò).
